subject.title: [Feature]: Deeplink/contentIntent support in system.notify for Android nodes

question: Should Android `system.notify` accept notification tap targets, and if so what targets may a gateway-sent payload launch?
rationale: The current code has a clear implementation gap, but the safe boundary is a maintainer security/product choice because a PendingIntent can launch native Android app surfaces from remote node commands.

options.title: Share allowlisted deeplink policy
options.body: Route notification tap targets through the same explicit allowlist/config and structured-error policy as the broader Android URL/deeplink launcher work.

options.title: Limit to OpenClaw-owned routes
options.body: Add contentIntent support only for OpenClaw app-owned navigation or approval routes and reject arbitrary external app deeplinks.

options.title: Keep notify passive
options.body: Leave `system.notify` as display-only and put all Android URL launching behind a separate explicit command if maintainers sponsor that capability.

recommendation.title: Share allowlisted deeplink policy
recommendation.body: Route notification tap targets through the same explicit allowlist/config and structured-error policy as the broader Android URL/deeplink launcher work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has adjacent node-command/security history, so he is the best available owner for the immediate policy decision.
